question: Vijayalaya, who belonged to the ancient chiefly family of the Cholas from Uraiyur, captured the delta from the Muttaraiyar in the middle of the 9th century and built the town of ______________.
solution:
The correct answer is __**Thanjavur**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__

• Thanjavur, also known as Tanjore, was a major city of the Chola dynasty.

• Vijayalaya Chola, the founder of the imperial Chola dynasty, captured Thanjavur in the middle of the 9th century.

• Thanjavur became the capital of the Cholas during the reign of Vijayalaya Chola.

• Thanjavur is renowned for its rich cultural heritage, particularly during the Chola period, which saw the construction of the famous Brihadeeswarar Temple.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

• **Vijayalaya Chola:**

• Vijayalaya Chola was the founder of the Chola dynasty that would go on to become one of the longest-ruling dynasties in the history of southern India.

• Before Vijayalaya's reign, the Cholas were chieftains and had lost their prominence to the Pallavas and Pandyas.

• Vijayalaya's capture of Thanjavur marked the revival of the Chola dynasty.

• **Muttaraiyar:**

• The Muttaraiyar were a dynasty of feudatories who ruled over the Tanjore region before the rise of the Cholas.

• Vijayalaya Chola defeated the Muttaraiyar to capture Thanjavur, setting the stage for the expansion of the Chola Empire.

• **Chola Dynasty:**

• The Chola dynasty was a Tamil dynasty that ruled primarily in southern India until the 13th century.

• The Cholas are well-known for their contributions to art, architecture, and administration.

• Some of the most remarkable architectural feats of the Cholas include the Brihadeeswarar Temple and the Gangaikonda Cholapuram Temple.

• **Thanjavur (Tanjore):**

• Thanjavur is located in the Indian state of Tamil Nadu.

• It was the capital city during the reign of the Chola dynasty and later the Nayak kingdom.

• Thanjavur is an important center of South Indian religion, art, and architecture, with the Brihadeeswarar Temple being a UNESCO World Heritage site.
